solutions.title: Right-to-left value compare
solutions.notes: O(n) right-to-left: subtract when smaller than previous
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Map symbols to values. Walk right → left; if current < previous value, subtract, else add. Subtractive pairs (IV, IX, …) fall out naturally.

**Complexity:** Time **O(n)**, space **O(1)**.

**Why preferred:** One uniform rule — no special cases per letter.

solutions.title: Lookahead subtractive pairs
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Switch on `I`/`X`/`C` and look ahead for subtractive pairs; otherwise add the map value.

**Complexity:** Time **O(n)**, space **O(1)**.

**vs recommended:** Same big-O and readable for learners. More branches to maintain. The right-to-left “smaller than next → subtract” pattern is shorter and less error-prone in interviews.
